## Checklist for records

- [ ] Each record is at `registry/scenarios/{id}.yaml`, and its `id` field matches the filename.
- [ ] New records have a new lowercase UUID as their `id`. Existing records keep theirs.
- [ ] Nothing in the record is private: no credentials, internal URLs, or personal information without consent.
- [ ] I searched the registry for an existing record of this integration.
- [ ] I have the right to share this information, and `license` (if set) covers the notes and linked code.
